policy: Time-boxed backend npm-audit exceptions, read only by scripts/audit-backend-production.cjs (never by the root/frontend gate). Each entry names one exact advisory, its package and the exact installed copies; severity high only, never critical; at most 14 days; it blocks again by itself when it expires. Adding or renewing an entry needs the owner's explicit approval.

exceptions.reason: The backend still uses zod 3 (about 40 files and 1000 schema calls). The fix for this memory-exhaustion advisory exists only in zod >= 4.6.6; the zod/v3 subpath is not patched. Every other copy of zod (root app and nested backend copies) is already 4.6.7. The backend migration to zod 4 removes this entry before it expires.
